title: Chapter 226 Chang Gui Can Speak Now
content:
Chapter 226 Chang Gui Can Speak Now

Wang Shuo came to the mine where Mira was.

It was pitch black in the mine, and you couldn't see your hand in front of you.

Wang Shuo lit a torch and walked with Duan Wenxi for a long time before arriving at Mira's station.

At this time, countless gold-eating demon worms were hatching, and Mira's body became even bigger.

"Mira, how are you doing recently?"

"Master, I'm fine."

Wang Shuo told her about the saltpeter mine and the gold mine, and wanted to hear her opinion on where to place them.

"Master, this kind of mineral deposit only requires you to mark an area, and the system will transform this land into a mining area. As for the location, it doesn't matter, as long as it's close to me."

Wang Shuo understood and directly placed the saltpeter mine and the gold mine next to the iron mine to facilitate Mira's descendants to mine.

At present, the gold-eating demon worms produced by Mira can provide 1,000 units of iron ore for the territory every day, and the output is still increasing.

Wang Shuo is still very satisfied with this.

After returning to the territory, Wang Shuo carefully sorted out the development plan of the territory.

Just at this time, Chang Gui also digested the soul crystal.

"Lord!"

A voice suddenly exploded in Wang Shuo's mind, scaring Wang Shuo.

"Who?"

"Me, Chang Gui!"

"You, you can speak?"

"Well, now you don't have to write a 'diary' anymore!"

"You came at the right time. What suggestions do you have for future development? And what major events will happen later, and we can take the lead from them?"

"My Lord, let me sort out my thoughts."

Wang Shuo's brows were lifted, and he looked forward to it.

Chang Gui said: "Lord, in the next period of time, it is a window period for the lords to quickly increase their strength and prepare for the next attack on the system town."

"Of course, the controller of the system town will certainly not let the wild lord succeed easily. The next battle will be very fierce."

Wang Shuo nodded, which was almost what he expected.

"Do you think other lords know that they are going to attack the system town?"

"In the short term, they probably don't know. According to my memory, when I was the village chief, a lord accidentally attacked a small town, and the news spread."

"What about the lords from outside the domain?"

"Of course they know, but for some reasons, they can't tell others for the time being."

Wang Shuo was thoughtful. It seems that the news given by Lord Zach is known to all players outside the domain.

Although so, it still gives Wang Shuo a slight advantage.

Wang Shuo plans to rest for a few days first.

Send Guliji out to explore the situation around the territory.

Let the spies sent out step up to get the news.

All soldiers will be stationed in the ancient battlefield in turn to train and upgrade their levels.

Since he can fully control the dungeon, Wang Shuo directly spawned a large number of undead according to the needs, simulated various undead arms, enhanced the army's actual combat experience, and upgraded their levels.

Soldiers who did not enter the ancient battlefield entered the Transmission Hall and the Loyal Soul Hall to practice and worship!

At the same time, let the craftsmen camp speed up the production of equipment.

And I stepped up to practice the "Black Dragon Sutra", study the "Craftsman's Manual" and the production of the Dead Spirit Orb.

In this way, seven days passed in a flash.

These days are the most leisurely days since Wang Shuo entered the survival game.

Guliji, who is responsible for investigating the news, came to report.

"Lord, I have found the traces of the horse bandits."

Wang Shuo smiled and finally could take action against them.
